routes./access/: Static button is visible for a resolved Identity or temporary session, but access.js has no listener and shared navigation does not bind existing static controls without data-private-logout. No session-revoke request, Identity logout, or redirect fires.
routes./access/manage: manage.js owns the static button handler: POST session revoke, Identity logout, then replace to /admin.html?returnTo=%2Faccess%2Fmanage.html.
routes./admin: admin.js owns the static button handler: POST session revoke, Identity logout, then replace to /.
routes./config/: private-navigation creates the button and owns its handler: POST session revoke, Identity logout, then assign to /.

routeLogoutAudit.gateGap: The access-surface boundary test covers only a dynamically created button when getElementById returns null; the access-session browser covers invitation redemption, not logout. No current gate exercises the pre-existing static /access/ control.
routeLogoutAudit.secondaryRisk: Existing handlers continue to Identity logout and redirect after a network error before the temporary-session revoke request reaches the function; in that case the temporary cookie may remain valid until expiry. This is separate from the inert /access/ control and needs a deliberate failure-state decision.

independentReview.result: copy-slice-coherent; separate P1 logout defect identified
independentReview.notes: The label slice is limited to fixed UI copy and does not change auth, roles, visibility, session, handler, endpoint, or redirect behavior. Route audit confirmed /access/ has a visible but inert static logout control; /access/manage and /admin use page-owned handlers; /config uses the dynamically created shared handler. Current test coverage misses the existing static /access/ button. A separate secondary risk exists when temporary-session revocation fails before reaching the function.

nextAction: Fix the /access/ static logout control by connecting it to the single existing shared logout handler, add a focused assertion for the existing-static-button path, and verify the exact-head access boundary gate. Review temporary-session network-failure behavior separately before deciding whether to change it. Keep LOC-006 partial and the ARC-13 inventory globally unreviewed.
